Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring helmets within public skate parks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to skate parks; and adding a new section to chapter67.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) Any person using or riding on a skateboard, bicycle,scooter, or roller skates within a publicly owned or operated skatepark shall wear an approved protective helmet. (b) The management of the publicly owned or operated skate park mayremove from or deny access to the skate park anyone violating (a) ofthis subsection. (2) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Approved protective helmet" means a head covering that meetsor exceeds safety standards adopted by a national standards testinginstitute, such as the American society for testing and materials,snell foundation, or United States consumer product safety commission. (b) "Bicycle" means every device propelled solely by human powerupon which a person or persons may ride, having two tandem wheels,either of which is sixteen inches or more in diameter, or three wheels, p. 1 SB 5116any one of which is more than twenty inches in diameter. For thepurposes of this section, the term "bicycle" shall include a bicyclewith training wheels, or any attached trailer, side car, and/or otherdevice designed to be, and being, towed by a bicycle. (c) "Roller skates" means a skate with at least four wheels,whether inline or not, for skating on surfaces other than ice. (d) "Scooter" means a board mounted upon or between two or moresmall wheels and controlled by an upright steering handle. (e) "Skateboard" means a foot board mounted upon four or morewheels and is usually propelled by the user who sometimes stands, sits,kneels, or lays upon the device while it is in motion. (f) "Skate park" means an indoor or outdoor ramp, course, or areaspecifically designated for the exclusive recreational or sporting useof skateboards, bicycles, scooters, or roller skates. The term doesnot include property used at any time as a public sidewalk, footpath,vehicle parking lot, multiple use trail, multiple use greenway, orother public way. (3) Nothing in this section creates a duty on behalf of owners oroperators of public skate parks to enforce this section.
